{{DISPLAYTITLE:Coeurl (''Tactics Advance'')}}
[[File:FFTA-spr-Coeurl.gif|left]]
[[File:FFTA_Coeurl_Portrait.gif|right]]
{{Quote|King of the red panthers. Turns prey to stone.|Description}}
The '''Coeurl''' in ''[[Final Fantasy Tactics Advance]]'' is a powerful blue beast related to the [[Red Panther (Tactics Advance)|Red Panther]]. It has high [[HP (stat)|HP]] and is dangerous to approach because of its [[Blaster (ability)|Blaster]] skill and high Attack power. There is usually never more than one Coeurl at a time.

{{See|Coeurl}}

==Appearances==
===Missions===
{|class="full-width FFTA article-table" style="text-align:center"
|-
!style="width:15%"|Mission
!style="width:25%"|Prerequisites
!style="width:70%"|Information
|-
!Mission #037: Village Hunt
|Complete Mission #003: The Cheetahs
|It is a good idea to have the units use the Judge and easternmost cactus to cover their backs when heading for the Coeurl.
|-
!Mission #004: Desert Peril
|Complete Mission #003: The Cheetahs
|The Coeurl begins on a mesa and should take at least three turns to reach the party. Try to eliminate closer enemies before it approaches.
|-
!Mission #100: Fiend Run
|Complete Mission #009: Magic Wood, Capture 5 monsters
|The four escaped monsters should be no match, unless the Ahrimans begins to KO most of the units with [[Roulette]] and the Coeurl petrifies the rest with Blaster.
|-
!Mission #052: Friend Trouble
|Complete Mission #012: Pale Company
|There are three Red Panthers and a Coeurl. Try not to let them surround the mages.
|-
!Mission #065: Exploration
|Complete Mission #016: The Big Find
|To unlock [[Jagd Ahli]], the monsters guarding the gate must be defeated. The Coeurl begins on the left side.
|-
!Mission #022: To Ambervale
|Complete Mission #021: Hidden Vein
|The Coeurl is backed up a group of other difficult monsters, including a [[Big Malboro]], [[Thundrake]], and [[Lilith (Tactics Advance)|Lilith]].
|-
!Mission #067: Missing Meow
|Complete Mission #191: Lucky Charm
|Disabling the Coeurl or putting it to sleep is recommended.
|}
